actions.name: Move
actions.description: If partnered, characters move as a pair, following the pattern of the dance. If unpartnered, characters move independently.

actions.name: Probe Secret
actions.description:
Gain a token from the supply, based on the following rules:
•Adjacent to an ally: gain Wits or Instructions.
•Adjacent to an enemy: gain Gossip or Blackmail.
•Adjacent to an NPC: gain a rumor.

actions.name: Tell Tales
actions.description: If adjacent to an enemy, they gain Chatter, or Misinformation if they're next to another of your allies.

actions.name: Read the Room
actions.description: Speak to the crowd -- test Charm to increase draw size by 1.

actions.name: Organize Threads
actions.description: Synthesize the information you've learned; test Wits to increase hand size by 1.

actions.name: Give Item
actions.description: Transfer an item from your inventory to an adjacent ally.

actions.name: Take Item
actions.description: Test Grace to transfer an item from another character's inventory to this character's inventory.
